senses.gloss:
अट् €1 P. (rarely Ā.) (अटति, आट, अटितुम्, अटित). To wander or
 roam about (with loc.); roam over (sometimes with acc.); भो वटो भिक्षामट
 Sk. go to beg alms; आट नैकटिकाश्रमान् Bk. 4. 12; महीमटन् Dk. 38
━desid. अटिटिषति. ━freq. अटाट्यते to wander about
 habitually, as a religious mendicant.

अट्ट् €1 Ā.
—1 To kill.
—2 To transgress, go beyond (fig. also). ━caus.
—1 To lessen, diminish.
—2 To despise, condemn, disregard.
